attempted_axis: Read-only re-screen of pmotion's three remaining non-exact non-PlayerMotion functions against the new hoisted-literal colouring law, which the TU's earlier per-label refcount sweep was structurally blind to. Negative on all three; no edits made.

attributes.axis_log: The new law's diagnostic tell is a pool lfs/lfd in the entry block immediately followed by an `fmr` into a callee-saved FPR whose NUMBER is below every float parameter's home, with the copied value never rewritten inside the loop. Read the first 0x60 of each target with tools/gdl/fnasm.py and the tell is ABSENT in all three. fn_80088714: no pool FP load at all in the entry; its only entry `fmr f31,f1` is the ordinary first-float-parameter home, and the FP constants it does use come from lbl_80282850 as an ADDR16_HA/LO table base, not an SDA21 scalar. PlayerCollideFloor: has an entry `lfd f4,lbl_80347B28(EMB_SDA21)` but it is CONSUMED IMMEDIATELY by the next-but-one `fadd f2,f4,f2` - a one-shot operand, not a loop-invariant held through a copy - and its `fmr f26,f1` is again a parameter home. get_player_pos: no FP pool load in the entry block at all; its prologue is integer (sMusicTrackHi test plus two ADDR16 table bases). So none of the three carries a hoisted-literal web, the lever that took PlayerCollidePlayers to byte-exact cannot apply, and the earlier pass's retirement of the extern-literal axis for these functions stands for a second, independent reason.
